title: VulnSAGE: Adjudicating SAST Reports by Connecting LLM Reasoning to Program Structure
abstract: arXiv:2610.23035v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Static Application Security Testing (SAST) reports flag operations whose safety depends on project-specific context, and maintainers must decide which reports describe real defects. Large language models (LLMs) can interpret this context, but adjudicating a report with them requires the decisive code, which often lies far from the reported line, and a decision basis that program analysis can check. We present VulnSAGE, an adjudication system for SAST reports that connects LLM reasoning to program structure in both directions. Its report-centered slicer recovers the dependencies of the reported operation together with the program structure that explains them, such as the caller object on which a helper acts. CLAIM, an intermediate representation for report judgments, records each model interpretation as a semantic fact that cites the program relations it assumes. translated_title: VulnSAGE：通过连接大语言模型推理与程序结构来裁决SAST报告
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.23035v1 公告类型：新 摘要：静态应用安全测试（SAST）报告会标记那些安全性依赖于项目特定上下文的操作，维护者必须判断哪些报告描述的是真实缺陷。大语言模型（LLM）能够解释这些上下文，但用它们裁决报告需要决定性的代码，而这些代码往往远离被报告的代码行，且需要一个可供程序分析验证的判断依据。我们提出了VulnSAGE，一个针对SAST报告的裁决系统，它在两个方向上将大语言模型推理与程序结构相连接。其以报告为中心的切片器（slicer）能够恢复被报告操作的依赖关系，以及解释这些依赖关系的程序结构，例如辅助函数所作用的调用者对象。CLAIM是一种用于报告判断的中间表示，它将模型的每一条解释记录为一条语义事实，并引用其假定的程序关系。程序分析会验证这些前提条件，最终裁决由事实推导得出。
tldr: VulnSAGE提出了一种裁决SAST报告的系统，通过双向连接大语言模型推理与程序结构，利用以报告为中心的切片器恢复决定性代码的依赖关系，并通过CLAIM中间表示将模型解释记录为可被程序分析验证的语义事实，从而实现可核验的缺陷判断。
en_tdlr: VulnSAGE is an adjudication system for SAST reports that bidirectionally connects LLM reasoning to program structure, using a report-centered slicer to recover decisive code dependencies and a CLAIM intermediate representation that records model interpretations as semantic facts verifiable by program analysis.
